lyrics:
[Verse]
I love you Lord,
And I lift my voice,
To worship you,
Oh my soul, rejoice,
Take joy, my King,
In what you hear,
Let it be a sweet, sweet sound,
In your ear.

[Verse]
We love you, Lord,
And we lift our hearts,
To honor you,
Oh my soul, rejoice,
Take joy, our King,
In what you see,
Let it be a pleasing sight,
In your eyes.
